summary: A broad sweep of platform decoder/encoder work improves hardware acceleration and HDR handling across many backends: FFmpeg updates, Vulkan Video enablement on Linux (including improved NVIDIA handling), fixes for HDR metadata propagation to the compositor so luminance and colors are correct, AppleVT/WMF state-machine hardening, and synchronized content-protection/CDM state to avoid races. These changes make hardware-accelerated playback and encoding more reliable and restore correct HDR colors and protections across platforms — **users should see fewer washed-out HDR videos and more stable hardware decode/encode behavior**.
